metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

metas.name: The Beast
metas.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

metas.name: Drink Coffee, Talk Fast
metas.description: Cast, crew, and fans trace the making of Gilmore Girls and the enduring pull of Stars Hollow, revealing how its stories shaped lives and connected generations.

metas.name: KILL/SAVE
metas.description: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.

metas.name: Long Haired Businessmen
metas.description: Kevin, Kyle, and Seth are long-haired, buzzword-fluent middle managers with a passion for staying looped in and on the same page. When the ruthless Torrence Group acquires their company and sics Gen-Z efficiency experts on them, the trio must survive team-building gone haywire, a scheme to replace them with AI, and a corporate conspiracy to eliminate middle management entirely - armed with nothing but jargon, synergy, and one sacred truth: the weekend’s never long enough.

metas.name: Deadbolt
metas.description: Anne Harrington is weighing a run for Congress when she comes home to find a door cracked open, one she is certain she locked. Within minutes, silence turns to dread, and dread turns to terror, as she realizes she is not alone in her own house. Trapped and hunted through the dark, she must outwit two violent predators who will stop at nothing.

metas.name: A Christmas Party
metas.description: Home for the holidays, Adam longs for the magic of his childhood. Amid the chaos of the annual Foxhall Village Christmas party, he dodges relatives, evades the political turmoil, and-surprise!-falls for his childhood friend.

metas.name: Magic in the Mundane
metas.description: A cinematic journey into the overlooked miracles of everyday existence.

metas.name: Falling
metas.description: A charming but emotionally guarded man takes a chance on love when he starts dating a woman, only to find himself caught in a complicated love triangle when his best friend falls for her too.

metas.name: Other Mommy
metas.description: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

metas.name: A COLD SEASON
metas.description: A lonely man's quiet winter routine hides a string of killings that spiral out of control when his dark double urges him toward madness.

metas.name: Gareth Reynolds: Why Aren't You Bigger?
metas.description: Filmed at The Den Theater in Chicago, Gareth Reynolds (We’re Here to Help, The Dollop) delivers a fast, funny hour about life in an increasingly automated America. From the robo-takeover of everyday life and the strange demands of an algorithm-driven culture to the healing power of animals and the uphill battle of making a living in modern entertainment, Reynolds finds the absurdity in a world that feels less human by the day. He also turns his attention to America’s billionaires, arguing that they are not only wildly powerful and deeply troubling, but embarrassingly lame. Building from sharp observations into a lively musical finale, the special brings its biggest ideas together in a closing number that is equal parts ridiculous, pointed, and unexpectedly catchy, suggesting that the antidote to all of this is the healing power of animals.

metas.name: Musk
metas.description: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

metas.name: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
metas.description: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

metas.name: The Holiday Hitman
metas.description: Hitman Hank Carter is trying to save his marriage with the perfect family Christmas. Unfortunately for him, a hit has been put on his head — and a gang of festive bounty hunters will stop at nothing to collect the payday.

metas.name: Jeffrey Dollmer
metas.description: Dahmer finds a doll in 1991 and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it but is captured before he can finish his evil plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers.

metas.name: Model Citizen
metas.description: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

metas.name: Kings of the Beach
metas.description: A documentary about the epic rise (and subsequent fall) of beach volleyball, featuring many of the boldfaced names from Southern California who helped popularize it.

metas.name: A Vision for Vision
metas.description: Directed and produced by 2x Emmy-award winning filmmaker Wayne Chesler, this special documentary follows Irish nutritional scientist Professor John Nolan’s 20-year exploration of the link between powerful antioxidants - Carotenoids - and their effects on nutrition, vision, and brain health. From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

metas.name: A Royal Christmas Secret
metas.description: When chef Emily Parker takes a job at Verdonia's royal palace for Christmas, she begins a romance with the castle's handyman Nick. But she doesn't know he's really Prince Nicholas and that his parents already have a bride picked for him.

metas.name: Christmas Owes Me Nothing
metas.description: From Fruit Bearing Studios comes a heartfelt holiday story about family, forgiveness, and finding hope in the most unexpected places. Christmas Owes Me Nothing follows two families navigating grief, broken relationships, financial hardship, and the pressures of the holiday season, only to discover that the true meaning of Christmas cannot be found in gifts, appearances, or tradition. As lives intersect through one unexpected opportunity, long-buried wounds begin to heal and hearts once hardened by disappointment are reminded that love, grace, and redemption still have the power to restore what seemed lost. Set against the warmth and tension of the holiday season, this uplifting drama blends heartfelt emotion, faith, humor, and community into a powerful story about second chances and the realization that sometimes the greatest gift is simply being seen, loved, and forgiven.

metas.name: Stellar Web
metas.description: A colonial settlement ship stops on a planet for fuel, but a stowaway brings aboard a horrifying threat that begins to tear apart the already dysfunctional crew.

metas.name: The Canvas
metas.description: In an isolated house, a father and his son discover a painting that seems disturbingly alive. When their darkest nightmares begin bleeding into reality, a sinister presence emerges from the canvas, feeding on buried trauma and forgotten memories.

metas.name: The Lost Ones
metas.description: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

metas.name: The Teenage Vampire
metas.description: When a straightlaced young woman moves into a chic bungalow in the Hollywood Hills she imagines nothing but raging parties and romance in her future. But Sandra's new dream house quickly becomes a den of horrors after she discovers her landlords are ancient vampires and her first party guests are the victims of a bloody massacre. As the night grows more sinister and twisted, Sandra unearths the most terrifying secret of all.

metas.name: Sticky
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of the relentless pursuit of stardom in Tinseltown, ‘Sticky’ delves deep into the lives of three intertwined souls, each grappling with their own demons amidst the whirlwind of love, manipulation, and the chilling realization that in Hollywood, the line between obsession and rejection is dangerously thin.

metas.name: The End of Nowhere
metas.description: A grieving woman wanders the beautiful and mysterious West Texas desert in her car searching for answers in the surreal and supernatural phenomenon known as "The Lights."

metas.name: Love Language
metas.description: After a failed engagement, a woman discovers a talent for writing wedding vows, but her growing success and new romance are complicated when she’s hired to write vows for her former college flame’s wedding.

metas.name: The 3 Killer Pigs
metas.description: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

metas.name: The Exit State
metas.description: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

metas.name: Capturing Bigfoot
metas.description: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

metas.name: Clean Hands
metas.description: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

metas.name: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
metas.description: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

metas.name: Forever My Lady
metas.description: When women start going missing across the city, detective Shanel Reid is forced into an investigation leading her to Sebastian a dangerous man, whose disturbing obsession with one woman could leave more bodies and broken families behind.

metas.name: Roof
metas.description: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

metas.name: Mindshare: The Download
metas.description: After joining Mindshare, Evan begins experiencing vivid flashes of a life he doesn't remember. The company insists these are normal side effects of neural acclimation, but Evan soon discovers that his memories have been edited, replaced, and repurposed. As he uncovers the identity of the man whose memories he carries, Evan realizes he is living a borrowed life, and Mindshare will do anything to keep him from reclaiming his own.

metas.name: Not A Love Story
metas.description: Alec and Chenoa rediscover their friendship after 10 years apart. But family feuds bring them unimaginable tragedy. They overcome the anger and heartbreak and eventually acknowledge their love for each other and find reconciliation.

metas.name: Land of Shadows
metas.description: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

metas.name: JINX
metas.description: After moving into her new home, Mia, a mute Girl, discovers a cursed dollhouse hidden in the attic. When her younger brother vanishes into thin air, she must unlock the relic's dark mysteries before the ancient hex claims his soul forever.

metas.name: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
metas.description: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

metas.name: How Hard Can It Be?
metas.description: Mallory, an ambitious New York reporter, is assigned to a story on the Best Small Town in America, sending her to Alabama. Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.
